purpose: Carry long-horizon software tasks through verified intermediate states so execution can branch, compare, and recover without replaying the entire trajectory.
problem: Long-running agent tasks become fragile when environment setup, hidden dependencies, ambiguous requirements, and partial failures compound faster than the agent can safely reconstruct prior state.
intended_outcome: An execution system can persist verified subgoal checkpoints, branch from known-good states, compare divergent trajectories, and materialize a bounded recovery to a verified ancestor with exact provenance.
